annotations.title: Send a test to a webhook

description: Use this when the user wants to check that a webhook or chat channel receives FlareWarden's alerts. Sends one test event to the destination now, records the delivery, and returns whether it arrived and the HTTP status. Owners and admins only. Not for the delivery history of real alerts: use list_webhook_deliveries.

webhook.description: The webhook's id (from list_webhooks) or its name.

name: test_webhook
title: Send a test to a webhook
